items.q: What time are Louisiana Lottery drawings held?
items.a: Draw times vary by game; times on this page use Louisiana local time (CT). See the Schedule section.

items.q: What is the minimum age to play the Louisiana Lottery?
items.a: You must be 21 or older to play.
Louisiana withholds state income tax on lottery winnings, in addition to federal tax. Federal withholding of 24% applies to prizes over $5,000.

items.q: How do I claim a Louisiana Lottery prize?
items.a: Smaller prizes at retailers; larger prizes at a claim center or headquarters. See How to Claim above.

items.q: What happens to unclaimed Louisiana Lottery prizes?
items.a: Unclaimed prize funds are directed to state programs per Louisiana Lottery rules.

items.q: What are today's Louisiana Lottery numbers?
items.a: The latest winning numbers for all games appear in the Latest Draw Results section above.

items.q: How do I check my Louisiana Lottery ticket?
items.a: Compare your numbers to the Latest Draw Results and complete official validation before claiming.
See the Jackpot Tracker below for whether top prizes rolled over and the next estimated jackpots.
